title: Normalize hex colour strings
prompt:
The theme editor stores colours in one canonical form, but people paste all sorts of hex strings. Please add an exported normalizeHexColor(input: string): string | null to src/color.ts.

Accepted input is a "#" followed by exactly 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits, in any letter case, with surrounding whitespace ignored. The result is always lowercase with the "#":
- 6 or 8 digits are returned lowercased: "#FF8800" -> "#ff8800", "#11223344" stays "#11223344".
- 3 or 4 digits are expanded by doubling each digit: "#AbC" -> "#aabbcc", "#abcd" -> "#aabbccdd".
- An alpha channel is always kept, even when it is ff.

Return null for anything else: a missing "#" ("ff8800"), more than one "#", any other digit count (1, 2, 5, 7, 9, ...), non-hex characters, whitespace inside the value, named colours, or an empty string.
acceptance: 6 and 8 digits lowercased (alpha kept), 3 and 4 digits expanded, surrounding whitespace trimmed, null for empty, bare '#', missing '#', '##', wrong digit counts, non-hex digits, inner space, 0x prefix and named colours.
difficulty_rationale: One function with clear accept/reject rules.
